1.title: Conservative Gay Rights Group Ends Support for Trans Causes
1.summary: The Log Cabin Republicans, which is dedicated to gay causes, says that trans rights advocates focus too much on minors.

2.title: Dolly Parton Was Someone We Could All Agree On. Even in Polls.
2.summary: Few could match the bipartisan support that Ms. Parton received in public opinion polls. Not even Taylor Swift.

3.title: In Canada and at Home, Deference to Trump Turns to Defiance on Tariffs and Other Issues
3.summary: While the president remains the most dominant figure in the world, other leaders and institutions are pushing back more vigorously than at the beginning of his second term.

4.title: How U.S.-Canada Tariff Negotiations Turned Into an All-Out Trade War
4.summary: Detailed accounts of the final hours of the negotiations show that, while the United States offered Canada what it said was the best deal of any country, what Canada had to give up in exchange was seen as unthinkable.

5.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
5.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

6.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
6.summary: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.
